_comment: Label macros transcribed from photographs of the tubs actually open, 2026-08-12.
These are the PRODUCT half of the saved-meal slots: the shake stays the same,
these change whenever something else is on sale. Kept here so a swapped brand
can be diffed against what the numbers used to be, and so the transcription
can be rechecked against the photo rather than retyped from memory.
Per SERVING as printed on the label. The slot decides how many servings its
measure amounts to -- see api/meal-template.js servingsFor().

creatine-monohydrate.label: Micronized Creatine Powder (Glanbia / Optimum Nutrition)
creatine-monohydrate.note: Supplement Facts panel, not Nutrition Facts: it lists 5 g creatine monohydrate and no energy or macros at all. Recorded as zeros because that is what the label asserts, NOT because the value is unknown -- an important difference when a slot with no product is skipped from the total.

milk-whole-organic.label: Organic whole milk (ADUSA / Salisbury NC)
milk-whole-organic.note: Poured 'until smooth', so no fixed measure. Estimate a cup unless the slot says otherwise -- and see the warning about unmeasured slots in the meal-prep notes.

yogurt-plain-whole.label: Stonyfield Organic whole milk yogurt, plain
yogurt-plain-whole.note: Label serving is 3/4 cup; the shake uses half a cup, i.e. 0.667 of a serving.

frozen-fruit-blend.label: Wyman's frozen fruit blend -- banana, strawberry, wild blueberry
frozen-fruit-blend.note: Label says 'Protein less than 1g'. Recorded as 0.5 rather than 0 or 1 -- rounding it to 1 inflates every shake, rounding to 0 is the same lie downward, and half a gram is the honest reading of 'less than 1'.

peanut-butter.label: NOT YET TRANSCRIBED -- photograph missing
peanut-butter.note: Five of the six labels arrived; peanut butter was not among them. Left null on purpose so the slot reports as uncounted rather than silently contributing zero. Two spoons of peanut butter is roughly 190 kcal / 7 g protein / 16 g fat, which is NOT written into the numbers above because a guessed macro that looks measured is the exact failure api/nutrition.js exists to avoid.
